root_cause.text: The `t7_param` configuration structure for the Amlogic T7 SoC reset driver was defined without initializing its `.reset_ops` member, resulting in a kernel null pointer dereference when the driver attempted to invoke the uninitialized reset operations.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds `.reset_ops = &meson_reset_ops` to the `t7_param` static structure in `drivers/reset/amlogic/reset-meson.c`, which the commit message notes fixes a "missing reset ops causing kernel null pointer dereference."
